summary.text: Luo Po Seal is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move aimed at Luo Po Valley. After refining myriad self Immortal Gu, he names creating this third variation as his true motive.

claims.text: On Cloud Cover Continent inside Lang Ya blessed land, after refining myriad self Immortal Gu and simplifying several related killer moves, Fang Yuan names his true motive as creating a third variation move, Luo Po Seal. Dreams from Lu Wei Yin’s immortal killer move, especially the third of three lifetimes, give him major inspiration for the seal, while myriad self Immortal Gu looks like a bridge past an earlier deduction hurdle. Among his secluded domains of heaven and earth, Luo Po Valley is the most suitable target for this offense, with Reverse Flow River already used for reverse flow protection seal and Dang Hun Mountain still under repair.

Against a rank eight, Fang Yuan can defend but lacks offense; one path is a secluded-domain rank eight offensive killer move, and Luo Po Valley is his best and only secluded-domain choice for that plan. Progress on Luo Po seal stays slow even with the light of wisdom, and he blames a huge obstruction from soul path attainment that is only master level.

When Heavenly Court attacks again, he still has not deduced Luo Po seal and has no offensive rank eight killer move, so reverse flow protection seal can defend him without threatening the four invading immortals.
Even without a successful Luo Po seal deduction, he still holds another hidden rank eight offensive method.

Fang Yuan succeeds in creating Luo Po seal only recently relative to capturing Jun Shen Guang, and he uses Luo Po Valley as the core of the move. When Luo Po seal strikes Jun Shen Guang, light path dao marks protecting that soul are destroyed, the soul is injured to the verge of death, and that damage to a rank eight Gu Immortal shows how powerful the seal is; compared with reverse flow protection seal and the Luo Po Valley core, that power is not treated as surprising.

Later, while preparing Luo Po seal inside yama battlefield against Meng Tu, the move’s aura is immense and Fang Yuan’s location is exposed; the seal he activates then is only quasi-rank eight because he still lacks rank eight immortal essence and has modified and weakened it a little. Once ready, the seal hits Meng Tu from afar, Meng Tu’s soul dissipates completely with not a trace left, and the body and immortal aperture remain for looting.
